attributes.board_name: Indiana Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology Board (Professional Licensing Agency)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs of state scientific and professional organizations; university courses beyond those required for initial licensure that pertain to SLP or audiology; live or recorded lectures/workshops relevant to the practice; programs of approved organizations under IC 25-1-4-0.2 (no Board application needed); self-study (journals, books, recordings, facility visits, meetings with professionals, writing articles) max 6 hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed less than one year at renewal: no CE required; licensed more than one year: the full 36 hours.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; clock hours must be earned within the biennial renewal period.
rules.notes: Licenses expire December 31 of every odd-numbered year. In-service and competency CE cannot be counted; a CPR course counts only at the first renewal. Reinstatement after 3-6 years expired needs 36 hours, after 6+ years 72 hours (36 in the last 2 years) plus the Indiana law exam. SLP support personnel (SLP assistants and associates) hold a separate license that expires December 31 annually ($25); the Board's page lists no CE hours for them.
